recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-39226 core source follow-up is needed; future clarifications about DeviceAssociation details should be handled through later DeviceAssociation-specific Jira issues rather than by reintroducing patient association content into Device.
issue_request: FHIR-39226 was a Published/Persuasive R4-raised Device issue asking to move patient association out of Device, with its final resolution explicitly linking to the FHIR-38904 disposition.
initial_application: The change was applied through the FHIR-38904 work: commit 620b8fa10c added DeviceAssociation, commit 97e59d026d removed the active Device.association and Device patient/subject search surfaces by commenting them out, and commit 7a135eb348 completed FHIR-38904 QA. The current fhir.ini actively lists both Device and DeviceAssociation and records Device.patient as moved to DeviceAssociation.
additional_context: FHIR-38904's accepted motion created DeviceAssociation to avoid placing patient-identifying association history in reusable Device instances. FHIR-38637 and FHIR-39009 were resolved by reference to the same disposition. Later R6 work, including FHIR-46011 and subsequent DeviceAssociation refactoring, clarifies the relationship in Device boundaries and keeps association data on DeviceAssociation rather than Device.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was needed because active Device source has no Device.association or Device.patient content, while DeviceAssociation carries subject/focus, period, patient search, and patient compartment membership and is linked from the Device boundaries narrative.
